title: blumea sylvatica var. macrophylla
intro: Blumea sylvatica var. macrophylla, commonly known as Large-leafed Blumea or Chinese Mugwort, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Large-leafed Blumea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, making it a valuable medicinal herb in traditional medicine.
